g_MN.meaning: the metric tensor of the eight-dimensional space-time: the squared proper length of a coordinate step is $\mathrm{d}s^2 = g_{MN}\,\mathrm{d}x^M\mathrm{d}x^N$.

idx_MN.meaning: coordinate indices; each takes the eight values $x_0, x_1, \dots, x_7$ (written 0 to 7).

T_MN.meaning: the energy-momentum tensor of all matter fields.
